## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Provider or protocol integration
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security hardening

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated
- [ ] `npm run check:structure`
- [ ] `npm run test:aimix`
- [ ] ESLint run on changed files
- [ ] `git diff --check`
- [ ] No secrets or private model data included
- [ ] No real-provider traffic added to routine tests

## Compatibility and risk

Document public API impact, migrations, rollback steps, new dependencies, and licensing considerations. Include screenshots for visible UI changes.
